messages:
Morgan: Heads up — promoting release 2026.03.19-rc4 to prod hit a blocker. promote-build job failing on artifact index write: shard lock timeout against registry-index-primary-1.

deploy-bot: [automated] Promotion paused for pipeline run 2141523456. Logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/2141523456 (access restricted).

Alex: Can you paste the error lines? I can try reverting the last index schema tweak if that's the cause.

Morgan: paste logs:
```
ERROR index_writer.go:214 writeShard(sha256:abcd1234...) timed out waiting for shard lock after 15s
node: registry-index-primary-1
op: WRITE_SHARD
caller: index_writer
stack: github.com/redwood/index/writer.go:214
```

Tanya: That looks like the compaction job pattern — heavy compaction can hold shard locks. @SRE-Oncall any visibility on compaction concurrency right now?

Evan: Oncall here. Seeing a compaction spike from compaction-operator v2 on primary. I'll pause compaction and see if locks free.

Morgan: If we pause compaction, do we risk index inconsistency? I'd prefer rollback if there's a chance artifacts will be partially registered.

Alex: Rollback to prod tag is simplest to keep customers safe. We can cut a hotfix branch to run backfill later.

deploy-bot: Note: rollback is manual. To revert, promote tag `prod-2026-03-12` via the console or run `deploy promote --tag prod-2026-03-12`. Current artifacts are immutable; promotion will use existing immutable blobs.

Tanya: Also would like release notes updated to mention the delay and the follow-up backfill. Our change window tomorrow 02:00 UTC — if we postpone, tell PMs and support.

Morgan: Action list:
- Evan: pause compaction (in progress)
- Alex: prepare rollback PR/manual promote to `prod-2026-03-12`
- Tanya: update release notes & ping PMs/support
- Morgan: open incident ticket with logs and add to postmortem

Evan: Compaction paused. Retrying a single promotion attempt now to see if lock is released. If it fails within 30s, we'll proceed with rollback.

Alex: Kicked manual rollback job (queued). If it finishes OK, we'll hold rc4 and schedule index backfill in staging before re-promoting.

Morgan: Thanks all. Keep this thread updated. :thumbsup:

SRE-Oncall: Filed infra change to limit compaction concurrency and added a short-term guard to avoid holding shard locks during peak promote windows. Follow-up ticket: INFRA-4872.

Morgan: Noted. I'll update the incident with INFRA-4872 and mark the release as delayed.
